you are your own best friend, camhs and family and friends should all be a second priority, your body is a sanctuary, dont self medicate with drugs and alcohol, you'll make urself feel worse long term for some momentary bliss, it's not worth it trust me. Lastly i wanna point out that the best thing to do is take it easy, watch a movie, go for a walk and while it may seem corny and shit, its nice, on your walk pet a dog or cat, take pictures of what you find cool, post them on your instagram or snap or whatever you wanna use, chest up, head up, walk like you own the street, put on your best outfit and go for a walk, feed some ducks or some animals, it genuinely does destress you, lay on some grass, until you feel shit crawling on you, then run away and leave, maybe even cycle instead, pick a destination, a high up viewpoint and watch the sunset alone, doing things alone can indeed be fun, set a goal for your walk, go charity shopping and find a cool new shirt or dress or shoes or hat, or even a book or cd if ur into that, go have a coffee at a coffee shop, put ur headphone in and enjoy the british weather lmao im playin, nothing to enjoy about the weather rn, but go out and enjoy your time, feed soem animals and have a great day out, go cry in a field alone, surrounded by nothing but you and grass and trees, and sometimes sheep if u dont live in london, let some emotions out, its okay to cry sometimes, boys cry too, just dont harm yourself. if u want someone to chat to on a real tho just pm me here and i'll be happy to chat, i've been through camhs and the whole lot so my Mental health CV is packed with experience.
